title: Choose VibeGuard's visual world
question: The roll assigned the pull-request review. Keep it, take my pick, adopt a challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: The Pull-Request Review
options.lineage: GitHub / GitLab code review: diffs, inline comments, Request changes
options.thesis: Your app gets the security review its AI builder never gave it: comments pinned to the exact lines.
options.viewport: A pull request titled with the user's app: a diff of Comment.jsx with three review comments threaded under the dangerous lines, 'Request changes' as the verdict, and the primary action 'Review my code'.
options.risk: Can read as a GitHub clone unless the review voice, type and verdict system are VibeGuard's own.

raised.raise: Confidence is drawn, not labelled: Confirmed comments solid, Likely regular, Needs review in a dashed hairline thread.
Severity is billed by type weight and size as well as colour, so the worst comment outranks the rest even in greyscale.
Scan progress is one unbroken row of check runs with a moving light marking 'now'.
Every comment's collapsed line is the whole summary; expanding it is only detail.

options.label: Red Pen
options.thesis: Your code handed back marked in red: lines circled, notes in the margin, the grade at the top.
options.viewport: A sheet of code with the risky lines circled in red ink, margin notes in plain English, and a big red F in the corner.
options.risk: Familiar school metaphor; a light paper ground drifts toward the cream-and-red default.

options.label: Soundsystem Poster
options.lineage: Jamaican dance posters on fluorescent card
options.thesis: Findings billed like sound systems, biggest risk in the biggest outlined caps.
options.viewport: The worst finding stacked in outlined block caps across a warning-yellow sheet.
options.case: Loud and memorable, but builders don't see themselves in it and it hides the code.
options.risk: Shouts where the product needs to be trusted.
options.kept: Rank carried by type weight, not colour alone.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: Each risk traced as a ribbon from source to sink.
options.viewport: One ribbon running from request input to the dangerous line.
options.case: Elegant for data flow, too academic for a builder before launch.
options.risk: Archival calm where urgency is due.
options.kept: Known, inferred and disputed drawn differently: our confidence levels.

options.label: Step Sequencer
options.thesis: The scan as a sixteen-step pattern lighting up.
options.viewport: A step row of scanners with a chase light.
options.case: A good progress metaphor, unrelated to reading a report.
options.kept: One unbroken step row with a light marking now.

options.label: Toy Window Boxes
options.thesis: Each finding a boxed set you open.
options.kept: The box front is the whole summary; opening it is only detail.

options.label: CRT Arcade
options.thesis: Your app's risk as a high-score screen.
options.viewport: Pixel caps listing findings like a score table.
options.kept: Colours reserved by law for one meaning.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Findings maturing like jars on a shelf.
options.viewport: Jars labelled by risk on a shelf.
options.case: No connection to code or builders.
options.kept: Every item wears the same label band.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A security-tool landing done impeccably: dark, precise, product screenshots.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, CTA and a screenshot of the report.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other scanner by design.
